notes: The official locations page separates Shaw - Restaurant & Mart at 1334 9th St NW from Columbia Heights - Restaurant & Bar at 3608 14th St NW and Bethesda - Cuisine at 4921 Bethesda Ave.
The separate ledger record chercher-ethiopian-restaurant-and-mart-washington-dc-dc-metro appears to describe this same Shaw establishment, not a fourth Chercher location.

sources.excerpt: Official Shaw page identifies Chercher Ethiopian Restaurant & Mart at 1334 9th St NW, Washington, DC 20001 and links its location-specific menu.
Official locations page lists three distinct establishments: Columbia Heights Restaurant & Bar, Shaw Restaurant & Mart, and Bethesda Cuisine.

Location-specific Owner ordering menu is headed Chercher Restaurant Shaw - Restaurant & Mart, shows 1334 9th St NW, and exposes 85 in-scope products after excluding the $0 QR promotion. The rendered menu contains no allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredient, gluten, dairy, peanut, or sesame disclosure.
The generic menu surface resolves to a different location presentation and is not used as the Shaw boundary; the Shaw location has its own explicit menu URL.

Active Grubhub surface identifies Chercher Ethiopian Restaurant & Mart at 1334 9th St NW and corroborates many Shaw products. It is not linked from the official site, so its ingredient descriptions are not treated as direct restaurant-linked allergen evidence.
Historical official-domain DC menu surfaced by document search, but the URL now returns 404 and does not provide a current allergen matrix.
Targeted domain and exact-business searches surfaced current menu pages and historical menu PDFs, but no product-level allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide, or cross-contact statement.

findings.summary: This record and chercher-ethiopian-restaurant-and-mart-washington-dc-dc-metro appear to represent the same 1334 9th St NW Shaw establishment; they should not be treated as separate Chercher locations.
The 34-row baseline omits most of the current 85-product Shaw menu and contains two menu-heading artifacts plus stale Oyster Bay.

proposedChanges: Anchor this restaurant ID to the official Shaw Restaurant & Mart page and location-specific menu at 1334 9th St NW; do not merge the Columbia Heights or Bethesda menus.

Replace the 34-row under-extracted baseline with the 85 consolidated Shaw products, excluding the $0 QR promotion and removing the Beef Entrees and Pasta Dinner heading artifacts plus stale Oyster Bay.

Preserve direct restaurant-issued positives only where the current product name or Fish category explicitly identifies fish, and for the Egg side; mark all other direct allergen data unavailable because no current official matrix or ingredient disclosure exists.
Resolve the duplicate canonical representation of the same Shaw establishment with the sibling ledger record at coordinator scope.
